tasks.label: G++: Direct Build
tasks.command: powershell -Command "if (-not (Test-Path build)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory build }; g++ -std=c++17 -municode -mwindows src/main.cpp -Ipackages/WebView2/include -Isrc packages/WebView2/lib/x64/WebView2Loader.dll -lole32 -loleaut32 -luser32 -lgdi32 -lshell32 -lcomdlg32 -lshlwapi -luuid -o build/M_MEdit.exe; Copy-Item packages/WebView2/lib/x64/WebView2Loader.dll build/ -Force; Copy-Item -Recurse assets build/ -Force; Write-Host 'Direct build finished.'"
tasks.detail: 使用 g++ 直接编译并复制依赖文件
